import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long K, P;
    static boolean[] used = new boolean[1000000];
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static void dfs(long curr) {
        if (used[(int) curr]) return;
        used[(int) curr] = true;
        dfs((curr * K) % P);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        P = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();
        long ans = 1;
        if (K == 1) {
            ans = (ans * P) % MOD;
        }
        for (long i = 1; i < P; i++) {
            if (!used[(int) i]) {
                dfs(i);
                ans = (ans * P) % MOD;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
